items.claim: Chanel Dyer is better everywhere and will outstrike Ellis Reed.
items.quote: I do think Chanel Dyer is better everywhere. It's probably going to be a striking match primarily and I think Chanel Dyer is going to outstrike her.

items.quote: I do like the way McVy uses his kickboxing a bit better. So I'm going to actually lean McVy in this fight.

items.quote: Gage Young's actually really good. Like I've I've followed Gage Young for a little bit. He's His striking's good. His fight IQ is pretty solid. He moves pretty well.
